name: Mugen no Zero
source:
Main character is blown into a mysterious space one day leaded by the voice of the girl asking for help. He has no other option but take the sword and slay monsters in this ever-changing labyrinth to recover his memories.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，主人公被一个呼救女孩的声音引导，来到神秘的空间。他别无选择，只能拿起剑，在不断变化的迷宫中斩杀怪物，以找回自己的记忆。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
